title: Toward Model-Driven Digital Twin Configuration: Separating Structure Semantics and Runtime with SysML SAREF and Ditto
abstract: arXiv:2609.04213v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy communities, neighbourhoods that jointly produce, store, and consume electricity, increasingly rely on \emph{digital twins}: live software copies of physical devices such as a solar panel, a battery, or a heater, kept in sync for monitoring and control. Setting up such a twin is today mostly manual: an engineer hand-writes a configuration whose field names are arbitrary, whose units are implicit, and which carries no machine-readable description of how devices relate, so other systems cannot reliably interpret it. This position paper argues that the task should be split across three complementary tools, each doing what it does best: a modelling language for the system's structure (SysML), a standard energy vocabulary for its meaning (SAREF4ENER), and a digital-twin platform for the running representation (Eclipse Ditto, via the W3C Web-of-Things Thing Description). translated_title: 迈向模型驱动的数字孪生配置：使用SysML、SAREF与Ditto分离结构、语义与运行时
translated_abstract: 能源社区——即共同生产、储存和消费电力的社区——日益依赖数字孪生：这是对太阳能板、电池或加热器等物理设备的实时软件副本，通过保持同步来实现监控与控制。目前搭建此类数字孪生主要依靠手工：工程师手工编写配置，其字段名称随意、单位是隐式的，且不包含设备之间关系的机器可读描述，因此其他系统无法可靠地解读这些配置。本立场论文认为，这项任务应当拆分给三个互补的工具，让每个工具各尽其长：用建模语言SysML描述系统结构，用标准能源词汇SAREF4ENER表达语义，用数字孪生平台Eclipse Ditto（通过W3C物联网事物描述，即W3C Web-of-Things Thing Description）实现运行时表示。我们给出了概念性规则（尚未是可执行的生成器），用于推导……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将能源社区数字孪生的配置工作拆分为三个互补工具的分工——用SysML描述系统结构、用SAREF4ENER提供标准语义、用Eclipse Ditto实现运行时表示，从而实现机器可读的模型驱动数字孪生配置。
en_tdlr: This position paper proposes dividing digital twin configuration for energy communities across three complementary tools—SysML for structure, SAREF4ENER for semantics, and Eclipse Ditto (via W3C WoT Thing Description) for runtime—enabling model-driven, machine-readable twin setup.
